description.label: Third version of my personal website. The project was developed with the aim of updating my skills and experiences, as well as serving as a portfolio for my projects. I also took the opportunity to apply my design and usability knowledge, focusing on a more fluid and pleasant experience for visitors.

Platform for managing and organizing boxes for Pokémon Home. The project served as a laboratory for practices of AI-assisted development, using patterns such as spec-driven-development with the OpenSpec framework.

An short narrative game. The game tells the story of the first residents of the city of Pintadas in Brazil with minigame excerpts between scenes. On this project I worked alone, as a game designer and programmer, in addition to creating the art.

Award-winning platform from MapBiomas, the project integrates geospatial data and information about Pernambuco's environment, improving state environmental management processes, with an emphasis on environmental monitoring, licensing, and oversight. On this project, I worked on the front end, building and maintaining pages and components, as well as integrating with the API.

A simple API for URL shortening. The project was developed with the aim of practicing the development of Restful APIs, using Node.js and TypeScript. The API allows URL shortening, storage in a database and redirection to the original URL.
Library to automate internal web scraping processes. Obtaining data efficiently and reusably for various internal projects.

The second version of my personal website. The site was developed with the purpose of showcasing my skills and experiences, as well as serving as a portfolio for my projects. I also took the opportunity to apply my design knowledge.
Platform with a countdown to the end of the academic semester at University in Feira de Santana, along with a calendar featuring automatic updates to assist the academic community.
First version of my personal website. It is currently outdated.
Platform that gathers information on where to watch live football matches, based on services available in Brazil. Developed as an academic project.
Platform featuring a listing of projects for fundraising, focused on the Legal Amazon region. I contributed by developing the API.
Platform focused on creating a network of researchers working in the Legal Amazon region. I contributed to the development of the API and data scraping.
Specializes in data intelligence and geoinformation systems. My work spans API development, responsive web interfaces, and CI/CD automation.

about.label: The company specializes in developing systems that integrate data intelligence and geoinformation to offer innovative solutions.

responsibilities.label:
Creating and maintaining Restful APIs with automated integration testing, using Node.js and TypeScript.
- Developing responsive interfaces in web applications, using React.

description.label: Worked on development and maintenance of Restful APIs using PHP (Laravel) for a pharmaceutical distributor investing in technology.

about.label: The pharmaceutical distributor, focused on the Bahian market, began investing in technology at the end of 2019 to keep up with the transformations in the sector.

responsibilities.label:
Development, creation, and maintenance of Restful APIs using PHP (Laravel), ensuring efficiency and scalability.
- Managing and maintaining databases with SQL Server and PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance.
- Direct contact with clients to understand needs, solve problems, and ensure proper system implementation.

description.label: Undergraduate course in Computer Science, conducted in a synchronous online format. During the program, I consolidated my knowledge and deepened studies in data structures and artificial intelligence, while also acquiring new learnings in areas such as computer graphics and Big Data.

Undergraduate course in Computer Engineering, focused on problem-solving and project development using the PBL (Problem-Based Learning) methodology. During the program, I acquired a solid foundation in software and hardware, understanding their integration, and deepened my knowledge in computer networks, compilers, software architecture, and machine learning. Additionally, I participated in extracurricular projects, such as being a member of the course's athletics team and a research scholarship recipient from CAPES.

Technical course in System Development, conducted in a face-to-face format. During the program, I acquired knowledge in programming, system analysis and design. Additionally, I was a student monitor, assisting my peers in programming logic and other subjects, reinforcing the learning of the class and developing mentoring skills, as well as helping the teachers directly with the organization of the class.

title.label: MasterChef ECOMP: The Recipe for Writing Good Code

description.label: The talk addressed the importance of learning the programming basics and making a correlation with cooking. The idea was to show that, just as in cooking, it is necessary to understand the ingredients and their functions to create an elaborate cake, in programming it is necessary to understand the concepts and their applications to create efficient and quality code.
